name: manual_3cfe09
claim: For v2 job claims, the planned Orchestrator Controller is an internal Oramasys module; a standalone repository remains a later option only through the documented admission gate. Perpetua-Tools remains the v1 coordination owner; Phylax remains the separate admission authority.

decisions.notes: Doc 68 and D-LG-7 place the planned controller inside Oramasys; the original standalone-only lesson is superseded in part while its separation-of-duties principle remains.

rationale: Doc 68 and D-LG-7 place the planned controller inside Oramasys; the original standalone-only lesson is superseded in part while its separation-of-duties principle remains.
